description: This source file defines the internal class CancellationSourcesExtension in the Orleans.Runtime namespace, which manages a list of cancellation token sources related to grain activations, including registration, cancellation, cleanup, and disposal logic.

classes.name: CancellationSourcesExtension
classes.description: Manages creation, registration, cancellation, and cleanup of grain cancellation tokens.

classes.name: CancellationSourcesExtension.Entry
classes.description: Represents an individual cancellation token with creation timestamp and expiration logic.

methods.name: CancellationSourcesExtension
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the extension with a logger factory and cancellation runtime, sets up cleanup timer and token creation delegate.

methods.name: CancelRemoteToken
methods.description: Attempts to cancel a remote token identified by GUID, logs failure if token not found.

methods.name: RegisterCancellationTokens
methods.description: Associates cancellation tokens within an incoming request, replacing wire token with fully created local token.

methods.name: RecordCancellationToken
methods.description: Records or retrieves a cancellation token by ID, optionally cancels if requested.

methods.name: ExpireTokens
methods.description: Removes expired tokens based on their age and the cleanup frequency.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the cleanup timer resource.

methods.name: Entry.Touch
methods.description: Updates the creation timestamp upon token activity.

methods.name: Entry.IsExpired
methods.description: Determines whether the token has expired based on elapsed time.

methods.name: LogCancellationFailed
methods.description: Logs a warning message when cancellation of a token fails due to token not being found.
